workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: jsonable_encoder collapses dicts with tuple or frozenset keys into raw strings due to TypeError: unhashable type: 'list'
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [issue-9341] [SDK] fix: stringify tuple/frozenset dict keys in jsonable_encoder. Target files: sdks/python/src/opik/jsonable_encoder.py, sdks/python/tests/unit/message_processing/test_jsonable_encoder.py. `jsonable_encoder.encode` replaced an encoded dict key with `str(key)` only when the key encoded to a `dict` (hashable dataclass keys). (Ref: https://github.com/comet-ml/opik/pull/9651)
